tokens.name: primary-normal
tokens.usage: Primary fill: the one main action per view, selected states, slider range.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary-normal. Skill 1 decides lighten vs darken so on-primary keeps contrast.

tokens.name: primary-heavy
tokens.usage: Pressed / active fill and primary strokes on soft surfaces. Not a text ground.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary-coloured text and icons: links, active tab label. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal and -elevated in every theme.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for primary badges, selected rows and callouts. Pair with primary-text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-normal, -strong and -heavy. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1 on the brand fill.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-normal. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-normal. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: secondary-normal
tokens.usage: Secondary brand fill: toggles on, progress, info highlights.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Secondary-coloured text and icons. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal in every theme.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for secondary badges and info callouts. Pair with secondary-text.

tokens.name: accent-normal
tokens.usage: Accent highlight: 'new' markers and featured moments. One per view.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal in every theme.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for accent badges. Pair with accent-text.

tokens.name: label-normal
tokens.usage: Default text: body copy, headings, control labels.

tokens.name: label-strong
tokens.usage: Maximum-emphasis text: display headlines, numbers that must win.

tokens.name: label-neutral
tokens.usage: Slightly quieter body text: descriptions, secondary paragraphs.

tokens.name: label-alternative
tokens.usage: Supporting text: helper text, metadata, captions. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal and -alternative.

tokens.name: label-assistive
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary hints, on background-normal / -elevated only.

tokens.name: label-disable
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons. Intentionally below 4.5:1; always paired with a disabled control.

tokens.name: background-normal
tokens.usage: Page ground and the default content surface.

tokens.name: background-alternative
tokens.usage: App shells, sidebars and sections that sit behind cards.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, dialogs, popovers, menus. Steps lighter in dark mode.

tokens.name: fill-normal
tokens.usage: Neutral fill: neutral badges, tracks, secondary button ground, skeletons.

tokens.name: fill-alternative
tokens.usage: Faint fill: hovered rows, quiet button hover, code backgrounds.

tokens.name: thumb-normal

tokens.name: thumb-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow under control thumbs, giving them an edge against light and coloured tracks.

tokens.name: line-normal

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: text fields, unchecked checkboxes and radios. Must reach 3:1 on background-normal.

tokens.name: status-positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: status-positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for positive badges and success callouts.

tokens.name: status-cautionary
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: status-cautionary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for cautionary badges and warning callouts.

tokens.name: status-negative
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, destructive outlines. If the brand primary is red, Skill 1 deepens this so error and brand never rely on hue alone. Must reach 4.5:1 on the page, in cards and on its own 10–25% tint (the destructive button and badge), in every theme; dark sits a step lighter than the other statuses for that.

tokens.name: status-negative-soft

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Information text and icons: a neutral fact or tip, neither success nor a problem. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: status-info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info badges and callouts.

easing.note: Motion curves. Reduced motion removes every scale and spring.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Fades, colour and shadow changes.

tokens.name: ease-expressive
tokens.usage: Anything that scales or slides. Tune to the brand: flatter for calm brands, more overshoot for playful ones.

tokens.usage: Colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-normal
tokens.usage: Presses and hovers.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Toggles and dialog entrance.

control.note: The control set's shared dimensions and text: Button, Input, InputGroup, Select, Combobox, Toggle and Textarea. Change these to change every control at once (density, a larger brand type); the heights stay a ladder (sm < md < lg).

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: Button and Toggle `size="sm"`, Select `size="sm"`, and the square icon button beside them. Tailwind: `h-(--control-height-sm)`.

tokens.name: control-height-md
tokens.usage: The default control height: Button, Input, InputGroup, Select, Combobox's field and Toggle, so controls side by side line up. Tailwind: `h-(--control-height-md)`.

tokens.name: control-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large controls: Button and Toggle `size="lg"`. Tailwind: `h-(--control-height-lg)`.

tokens.name: control-padding-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside a control: Button, Input, Select's trigger, Combobox's field, Toggle and Textarea. Tailwind: `px-(--control-padding-x)`.

tokens.name: control-label-sm
tokens.usage: Text in small controls: a type style from the scale, whose size, line height and letter spacing it takes (each control keeps its own weight). Tailwind: `text-(length:--control-label-sm-size) leading-(--control-label-sm-leading) tracking-(--control-label-sm-tracking)`.

tokens.name: control-label-md
tokens.usage: Text in default and large controls, and what people type in fields from the md breakpoint (below it fields stay 16px, so phones don't zoom on focus): a type style from the scale, whose size, line height and letter spacing it takes (each control keeps its own weight). Tailwind: `text-(length:--control-label-md-size) leading-(--control-label-md-leading) tracking-(--control-label-md-tracking)`.

layer.note: Stacking order across the product: z-index values, read as z-(--layer-*). Inside one component, local order (z-10 over its own siblings) stays in code.

tokens.name: layer-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky page headers and toolbars, above the page and below every overlay. Tailwind: `z-(--layer-sticky)`.

tokens.name: layer-overlay
tokens.usage: Every overlay: dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, selects and tooltips, with their backdrops. Tailwind: `z-(--layer-overlay)`.

breakpoint.note: Screen widths where layouts change. They are Tailwind's own sm/md/lg/xl/2xl, so `md:` follows these values; use-mobile reads breakpoint-md. Keep them in rem and in order.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones in landscape. Tailwind: `sm:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: below it is mobile (use-mobile, the Sidebar's sheet, fields' 16px text, display and title sizes' mobile steps). Tailwind: `md:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops. Tailwind: `lg:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Desktops. Tailwind: `xl:`.

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide screens. Tailwind: `2xl:`.

icon.note: Icon sizes. Components size their icons with these; an icon's stroke colour comes from its text token.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icons in the smallest controls (Button xs, a chip's remove). Tailwind: `size-(--icon-xs)`.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in small controls (Button and Toggle sm). Tailwind: `size-(--icon-sm)`.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: The default icon: in controls, menus, alerts and fields. Tailwind: `size-(--icon-md)`.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons that lead a block: an empty state's media, a large button. Tailwind: `size-(--icon-lg)`.

tokens.name: icon-xl
tokens.usage: Standalone icons. Tailwind: `size-(--icon-xl)`.

border.note: Line widths: every border's default width, and the focus outline every focusable control shows.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: The width of every `border` (Tailwind's default border width follows it): control borders, dividers, card outlines.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: The focus outline's width on every focusable control (the global :focus-visible rule). WCAG 2.2 asks for at least 2px.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: The gap between a control and its focus outline.

contrastMore.note: What changes when someone asks their OS for more contrast (prefers-contrast: more): each token on the left takes the value on the right, in every theme the app renders. Lines strengthen, secondary text darkens, the focus outline thickens. Design owns these like any token.
